Grace (Docs): Quick thread — we have multiple small fixes needed for the function/tool-calling and structured-output docs: stale SDK snippets, schema example that still uses `tool_output`, and one bad internal link. I opened a tiny PR to centralize examples and add a migration note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7988

Ravi (SDK): I can take the TS side. Which examples are highest priority?

Grace (Docs): `examples/ts/funcCallExample.ts`, `docs/tool-calling.md` snippet, and the structured-output sample in `docs/structured-output.md`. Please update method names (`callTool` -> `invoke`) and types.

Lin (DevEx): I'll handle Python snippets and double-check the Quickstart snippets on the website. Also want to add a tiny runnable example that shows streaming vs non-streaming responses.

Priya (Infra): There's a redirect we need for the old examples URL after docs deploy. I can open a frontend infra ticket once you tell me the old path.
docs-bot: PR #7988 opened by @Grace — link-checker: 1 dead internal link (old examples site).

Grace (Docs): Migration guidance proposal (short):

1) Use `output` envelope instead of `tool_output` in examples.
2) Add JSON Schema snippet: ```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {"output": {"type":"object","properties":{"result":{"type":"string"}},"required":["result"],"additionalProperties":false}},
  "required":["output"]
}
```
3) Provide one-liner legacy shim: `resp.get("output") or resp.get("tool_output")`

Ravi (SDK): LGTM. I'll include both the new API `client.invoke(...)` example and a legacy compatibility snippet with a short comment. Also adding a TS type alias so code compiles for older SDK users.

Lin (DevEx): For Python sample, recommend `RedwoodClient.invoke(..., stream=False)` and a streaming variant using `for chunk in resp.stream():`. I'll add both.

Priya (Infra): Opened infra ticket IR-9321 for redirect; leaving note to update after doc merge.

Grace (Docs): Perfect. Target: merge tomorrow morning. After merge I'll add a small docs- CI check that validates the JSON examples against the included schema. Tag me if you hit any blockers. :sparkles:
